name: Default and secondary choices for ScraperType

scenarios.name: Use default values when none provided

steps.text: I have an empty ScraperType configuration
the Scraper should use "requests" as the default scraper engine
the Scraper should have no browser configured

scenarios.name: Use secondary choice when primary unavailable

steps.text: I have a ScraperType configuration with "scraper_engine" set to "playwright"
Playwright is not available on the worker node
the Scraper should fall back to "requests"
